title: Planning Commission appointment fight and lawsuit
summary: On Feb. 21, 2025, the council rejected a nominee to the Maui Planning Commission on a 5-4 roll call vote. Last August, an amendment moving one nominee to the rejected list passed 5–4. In July 2024, a motion to approve a nominee failed 2–5, and a commission meeting could not proceed that day because too few members were present.
